description: This PHP source file defines the 'Accounting' class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically part of the style number formatting wizard. The class extends 'Currency' and provides functionality to generate accounting-style number formats, handling locale and currency symbol formatting.

classes.name: Accounting
classes.description: A class for creating accounting style number formats, including locale and currency formatting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Accounting object with currency code, decimal places, locale, and formatting options.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Returns the locale-specific number format string for accounting style, using Intl extension and ICU version checks.

methods.name: icuVersion
methods.description: Returns the ICU version as a float for compatibility checks.

methods.name: formatCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for the currency symbol or code, considering locale.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns the complete number format string for accounting style, considering locale, currency position, and spacing.
